lead.headline: BUKA reports results through Q3 2026, swings to Rp885.8 billion net loss
lead.blurb: Bukalapak’s revenue through the third quarter rose 19.34% year on year to Rp5.64 trillion, but it moved from a Rp2.9 trillion profit a year earlier to a loss. A Rp2.03 trillion investment loss, versus a Rp2.32 trillion profit, contributed to an operating loss of Rp1.13 trillion. Adjusted EBITDA turned positive at Rp11 billion, an improvement of Rp64 billion, which Director Victor Putra Lesmana attributed to business transformation and cost discipline.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Rakyat Indonesia plans a second-phase share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BBRI plans second-phase buyback of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The program runs from 22 October to 21 January 2027. BRI plans to use repurchased shares for employee and/or board ownership programs, with transfers subject to approval at a General Meeting of Shareholders.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Sumber Global Energy repays its Rp273.64 billion bond
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: SGER repays Rp273.64 billion in Series A bonds
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Sumber Global Energy's Series A bonds carried a fixed 10% annual coupon and a 370-day tenor, with proceeds used for working capital, mainly coal procurement and supplier payments. Its hydrogen peroxide plant in Merak is commencing its run test, with capacity of 20,000 metric tons per year at 100% concentration.

earnings_guidance.event: ANTAM reports first-half results and continues studying a share buyback
earnings_guidance.headline: ANTM reports Rp6.91 trillion first-half profit and continues buyback study
earnings_guidance.blurb: Aneka Tambang's revenue rose 6.3% to Rp62.71 trillion and net profit increased 34% year on year. Corporate Secretary Wisnu Danandi Haryanto said the company is weighing market conditions, fundamentals, financial capacity and funding needs for operations and downstream development before deciding on a step.

earnings_guidance.event: PTBA reports first-half profit growth and reviews a potential share buyback
earnings_guidance.headline: PTBA reports first-half profit up 218% and studies potential buyback
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bukit Asam’s first-half revenue rose 8% year on year to Rp22.03 trillion, while net profit increased 218% to Rp2.65 trillion. It has announced no buyback decision and says any decision will be disclosed to OJK and the Indonesia Stock Exchange.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Tabungan Negara expects slower second-half profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BBTN expects second-half profit growth to slow from first-half 40.8%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Tabungan Negara said rising funding costs, including deposit rates above 8% offered to large institutions, are pressuring industry profits. Its first-half net interest income fell 8% year on year to Rp8.59 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank BTPN Syariah reports Rp1.01 trillion in nine-month net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: BTPS reports Rp1.01 trillion nine-month net profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: BTPN Syariah’s assets rose 8% year-on-year to Rp24 trillion and financing grew 13% to Rp11 trillion as of September 2026. Return on assets was 7.3% and capital adequacy ratio was 59%, with Director Fachmy Achmad attributing the results to financing-quality and risk management.

macro_flows.event: MSCI reclassification concerns prompt capital outflows and a lower IHSG target
macro_flows.headline: MSCI downgrade proposal prompts outflows and Kiwoom cuts IHSG target to 5,700–6,000
macro_flows.blurb: Kiwoom lowered its year-end 2026 target from 7,000, citing foreign investor outflows and uncertainty over market recovery. Investors can submit feedback on MSCI’s proposal through 30 April 2027, with a final decision due by 30 June 2027.
